items.rationale: The confirmed surge damage is covered under 2.3.3 and 4.2.4. Equivalent replacements under 7.1.9 are estimated at €1,300 gross for both items, below the €5,000 aggregate cap; the missing surge protection reduces that amount by 50% to €650.

items.description: Surge diagnostic report and technician call-out
items.rationale: The bundled line primarily documents the failure and checks wiring safety rather than repairing damage, so 7.1.10 weighs against payment. If the attendance qualifies under 7.1.8(d), €120 allows for the one documented visit, not the three billed units.
